create_payment_intent_ai.description: Create a Stripe PaymentIntent to start a payment flow.

amount.label: Amount
amount.description: The amount to charge, as a decimal in the major currency unit (e.g., 10.50 for $10.50).

currency.label: Currency
currency.description: The three-letter ISO currency code (e.g., usd, eur, gbp).

customer.label: Customer ID
customer.description: The Stripe customer ID (e.g., cus_...) to associate. Obtain it from Search Customers or List Customers.

payment_method.label: Payment Method ID
payment_method.description: The PaymentMethod ID to attach (e.g., pm_...). Required to confirm the payment immediately.

confirm.label: Confirm Payment Immediately
confirm.description: If true, Stripe attempts to charge the provided payment method. Requires a Payment Method ID and a Return URL.

capture_method.label: Capture Method
capture_method.description: When to capture funds. 'automatic' (default) captures immediately on confirmation; 'manual' authorizes only — funds are held and you capture later with Capture Payment Intent (auth-and-capture).

return_url.label: Return URL
return_url.description: URL to redirect the customer back to after authenticating the payment. Required when confirming.

receipt_email.label: Receipt Email
receipt_email.description: Email to send a receipt to. Overrides the customer's email.

create_invoice_ai.label: Create Invoice
create_invoice_ai.description: Create a draft invoice in Stripe.

customer.description: The Stripe customer ID (e.g., cus_...). Obtain it from Search Customers or List Customers.

currency.label: Currency
currency.description: The three-letter ISO currency code (e.g., usd).

collection_method.label: Collection Method
collection_method.description: How to collect payment. 'charge_automatically' (default) charges the customer's default payment method when finalized; 'send_invoice' emails the customer a payable invoice (requires Days Until Due) and is the only method that lets you later call Send Invoice.

days_until_due.description: Number of days until the invoice is due. Required when Collection Method is 'send_invoice'.
